_comment: growth-sprint per-project config. Copied to <your-projects-root>/<project>/growth-sprint/config.json on the first run. budget_cap_eur: default cap of a sprint when the founder gives none, on cash spent on optional paid APIs from the founder's own accounts (image-model photo backgrounds, paid SERP calls, paid GEO panel runs), never ad spend (0 = no paid call). alert_ratio: share of the cap that records a budget alert. max_wave: steps in flight at once, 1 to 3 (1 = strictly sequential, also the fallback without subagents). approvers: names allowed in `sprint.py approve --by` (empty = any person's name; agent and tool names are always refused). reuse_if_fresh_days: per agent, how recent its outputs must be to skip its step (copied into each step of the plan by the planner). agents_excluded: agents never planned for this project. Optional: a "tools" object (same keys as shared/tools.example.json, for example {"critic": "builtin"}) overrides the project's tools.json for this agent.
